title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic diagram of Two-piece handicap

explain.ja: 図1-1は2枚落ちの基本図で、上手は飛車と角を落としています。上手には大駒がないので攻撃力はありませんが、守りの陣形はしっかり組めます。そのため下手には正確な攻めが求められ、2枚落ちで陣形を崩すのは平手と同じくらい難しいです。
explain.en: 図1-1 is the basic position of the two-piece handicap, where White has removed the rook and bishop. White has no major pieces and so little attack, but can still build a solid defensive formation. Black therefore needs to attack accurately, and breaking through in a two-piece game is about as hard as in an even game.

section.ja: 二枚落ちでの指し方、位を取りに行こう
section.en: How to play a two-piece handicap game: go for the position

explain.ja: 2枚落ちでは、下手はまず▲4五歩と突いて4筋の位を取るのがポイントです。これは上手に△4四歩と突かせないための手で、△4四歩がなぜいけないかは後の補足で説明します。歩を五段目まで進めることを「位を取る」と言い、今回は4筋の歩を進めたので「4筋の位を取る」と表現します。
explain.en: In the two-piece handicap, Black's key first move is ▲4五歩, taking the 4th-file position. This prevents White from playing △4四歩; why that is bad is explained in the note later. Advancing a pawn to the fifth rank is called "taking a position", so here Black takes the 4th-file position.

line.text: △6二銀、▲7六歩、△5四歩、▲4六歩、△5三銀、▲4六歩

explain.ja: 下手は3筋の歩も伸ばします。この手は、将来▲3四歩、△同歩、▲1一角成のように、角のラインを使った攻めを見せる狙いがあります。
explain.en: Black also advances the 3rd-file pawn. This aims at a future attack along the bishop's line, such as ▲3四歩, △同歩, ▲1一角成.

section.ja: 位を守るために銀を前に出す
section.en: Advance the silver to protect the position

title.ja: 図1-4 銀を前に出して歩を守る
title.en: Figure 1-4: Advance the silver to protect the pawn

explain.ja: 歩を伸ばしたら、次は銀を前に出します。これは伸ばした歩を守るための手で、4五の歩を取られそうになったら▲4六銀として歩に支えをつけられるようにしています。位を取った後に銀を出して歩を守るのは、よく出てくる手順です。
explain.en: After advancing the pawns, Black brings the silver forward to protect them. If the pawn on 4五 is threatened, Black can play ▲4六銀 to support it. Taking a position and then bringing out a silver to guard the pawn is a very common sequence.

section.ja: 位を守るために銀を前に出す
section.en: Advance the silver to protect the position

explain.ja: 4筋に続いて3筋の位も取ります。機を見て▲3四歩と突き、角のラインを利用して3筋を攻める手を狙っています。序盤のうちに2つの位を取るのが2枚落ちの定跡で、ここから「2歩突き切り定跡」と「銀多伝」の2つの定跡に分かれていきます。
explain.en: After the 4th file, Black takes the 3rd-file position too, aiming to play ▲3四歩 at the right moment and attack on the 3rd file using the bishop's line. Taking two positions early is the standard approach in the two-piece handicap, and from here it branches into two joseki: the Two-Pawn Push-Through and Ginta-den (Silver Rapid Attack).

title.ja: 図a-1 △4四歩とされると角が使いにくい
title.en: Figure a-1: After △4四歩 the bishop is hard to use

explain.ja: 2枚落ちの定跡ですぐ▲4五歩と位を取るのは、上手に△4四歩と突かせないためです。図a-1のように△4四歩と突かれると、下手の角の利きが途中で止まって攻めに使いにくくなり、上手が少し良くなります。
explain.en: The reason the two-piece joseki immediately plays ▲4五歩 is to stop White from playing △4四歩. If White plays △4四歩 as in 図a-1, the line of Black's bishop is blocked partway and hard to use for attacking, which gives White a slightly better game.

title.ja: 図a-2 平手では△4四歩は問題ない
title.en: Figure a-2: In an even game, △4四歩 is no problem

explain.ja: 一方、平手では△4四歩をそこまで警戒する必要はありません。こちらの角が使いにくくなると同時に、相手の角も使いにくくなるからです。平手では相手も角を持っているため、△4四歩の意味合いが変わってきます。
explain.en: In an even game, on the other hand, △4四歩 does not need to be feared so much, because while your bishop becomes harder to use, so does the opponent's. Since the opponent also has a bishop in an even game, the meaning of △4四歩 is different.

title.ja: 図2-1 2歩突き切り定跡の基本図
title.en: Figure 2-1: Basic diagram of the Two-pawn push-through joseki

explain.ja: 図2-1は2歩突き切り定跡の基本図です。この定跡では飛車を3筋に回し、3筋を集中して攻めます。攻めが主体の陣形なので、攻めが好きな人に向いています。
explain.en: 図2-1 is the basic position of the Two-Pawn Push-Through joseki. Black swings the rook to the 3rd file and concentrates the attack there. It is an attack-oriented formation, suited to players who like attacking.

title.ja: 図2-2 銀多伝定跡の基本図
title.en: Figure 2-2: Basic diagram of the Gintaden joseki

explain.ja: 図2-2は銀多伝定跡の基本図です。4筋に銀が縦に2枚並ぶのが特徴で、じっくり囲いながら少しずつ優位を築いていく、守りが主体の陣形です。じっくり指したい人には銀多伝が向いています。
explain.en: 図2-2 is the basic position of the Ginta-den joseki. Its hallmark is two silvers stacked vertically on the 4th file; it is a defense-oriented formation that builds castle-like solidity while gaining small advantages step by step. It suits players who prefer a patient game.
